messages.content: Solve the mathematics question using the provided image. Give a clear final answer at the end. For a multiple-choice question, include the option letter in your final answer.

content.text: A panel consists of 4 circles. Touching a circle changes its color and the color of every circle touching it, from white to black or from black to white, as shown. Starting with all circles white, what is the minimum number of successive touches needed to turn all circles black?
